views.rationale: Net income rose to $15.8 billion in 2015 from $5.5 billion in 2014, driven by a $15.2 billion drop in litigation expense
Sales fell 18% to $38.537 billion in 2016, and the company posted a $67 million loss versus a $2.512 billion profit in 2015
Investment banking revenues were $7.03 billion for 2015, 9% higher than 2014
Worldwide sales increased 2.6% to $71.9 billion in 2016
Home‑equity net charge‑off rate fell to 0.34% in 2016 from 0.45% in 2015 and 0.65% in 2014
Net income attributable to NEE rose to $2.91 billion in 2016 from $2.75 billion in 2015
Net earnings attributable to Procter & Gamble increased 146% to $7.875 billion in 2016 versus $3.206 billion in 2015
Total revenues grew 18% to $184.84 billion in 2016 from $157.11 billion in 2015
